description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

STERIS is hiring a Software Engineer I to support new and ongoing engineering projects by implementing, testing, and debugging software. The role also involves code reviews, unit testing, defect resolution, software process documentation, and support for embedded hardware and HMI development.
Software Engineer I implementing, testing, and debugging applications; resolving defects and producing requirements and verification documentation

Responsibilities:
• Participates in code reviews and/or inspections to ensure proper implementation of defensive coding practices
• Implements, tests, and debugs applications according to corporate policies and business operating procedures on new and sustaining engineering projects
• Collaborates on resolving issues found during testing
• Collaborates with software team members to propagate good coding principles and development practices
• Assists with software development process documentation to include requirements, interface specifications, and verification documentation
• Performs unit testing to ensure software meets specifications and expectations
• Resolves software change requests and defects
• Work as a collaborative team member on engineering projects

Requirements:
• Bachelor's in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or Electrical Engineering (A degree in another Engineering discipline may be acceptable with proven software education and/or training and demonstrated software experience.)
• 1+ year overall of related software engineering experience in development
• 1+ year experience of software development in Python, C, C++, or C# is required
• Experience with developing on embedded Linux or windows platform
• Exceptional team player and problem-solving abilities

Preferred:
• Preferred experience using software integrated development environments (IDEs) and tools including compiling/building, debugging, configuration management (version control), defect management, continuous integration, and code analysis tools
• Preferred knowledge of embedded hardware and HMI development is desired
• Preferred experience using AI-assistant development tools
